title: Witness sketch of windowed craft with flame exhaust on hotel letterhead (Fig. 8)
description: Photographic reproduction, shown sideways, of a hand sketch on "HENRY GRADY HOTEL" stationery depicting a rounded, elongated craft with two rows of rectangular windows and a flame-like exhaust streaming from its rear. Annotations include "LARGE WINDOW OR OPENINGS", "100' LENGTH", "NO FINS", a flame-length note, and a circle labelled "ESTIMATED FRONT VIEW ROUND"; a signature appears at lower right. Labelled "Fig. 8" in the margin.
